WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    COUNT(*) as circuit_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
total_count_calc AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_races
  FROM races
),
circuit_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.circuitId,
    cc.circuit_count,
    CAST(cc.circuit_count AS REAL) / tc.total_races as proportion
  FROM circuit_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN total_count_calc tc
  WHERE tc.total_races IS NOT NULL
),
avg_proportion_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_prop
  FROM circuit_proportions
),
filtered_circuits AS (
  SELECT 
    cp.circuitId,
    cp.circuit_count,
    cp.proportion,
    cp.proportion - ap.avg_prop as diff
  FROM circuit_proportions cp
  CROSS JOIN avg_proportion_calc ap
  WHERE ap.avg_prop IS NOT NULL
    AND cp.proportion > ap.avg_prop
)
SELECT 
  circuitId,
  circuit_count,
  proportion,
  diff
FROM filtered_circuits
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN diff IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  diff DESC
LIMIT 10
